name: knowledge
description: The agent's durable memory: notes with tags + full-text-ish search, over HTTP. Store facts on sight, retrieve them instead of re-asking.
post_install: Restart the platform: docker compose restart endpoint-platform (applies 007_knowledge.sql, hot-loads the app).
Store a note: curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:{{PORT_PLATFORM}}/api/knowledge/notes -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"title": "...", "body": "...", "tags": ["home"]}'
